definitions.gloss: bad influence; harmful effect; adverse impact
definitions.explanation: A negative effect that something has on a person, situation, or environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悪影響|あくえいきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It has a bad effect on health.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悪影響|あくえいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Excessive smartphone use has a harmful effect on children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{汚染|おせん}→環境汚染：21102_kankyouosen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生態系|せいたいけい}→生態系：04626_seitaikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{悪影響|あくえいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{及|およ}ぼしている→及ぼす：02028_oyobosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: It became clear that environmental pollution is having an adverse impact on the ecosystem.

notes:
{悪影響|あくえいきょう} means bad influence or harmful effect. Frequently used in news, health, education, and environmental discussions.

FORMS:
{悪|あく} (bad) + ⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ (influence, effect). The opposite is {好影響|こうえいきょう} (positive influence), though this is less commonly used.

- {悪影響|あくえいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to have a bad influence on
- {悪影響|あくえいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{及|およ}ぼす→及ぼす：02028_oyobosu⟧: to exert a harmful effect on (more formal)
- {悪影響|あくえいきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: harmful effects appear
- {悪影響|あくえいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be affected negatively
